title: Looking for Tips on Pitching with Generative AI!
author: MrMiichou
selftext:
Hey !

I’m exploring how to use generative AI tools (like ChatGPT, MidJourney, etc.) to craft and deliver pitches, whether for business, creative projects, or even startups. I’m curious to hear from people who’ve experimented with this:

1. How do you integrate AI into the process of crafting your pitch?
2. Do you focus on idea/tool for generation, storytelling, visuals, or all of the above?
3. Any specific tools, workflows, or tips you’d recommend for using AI effectively?
4. Have you encountered any pitfalls or challenges while relying on AI in a pitch?

I’m aiming to use AI to create something that’s not only polished but also truly engaging and memorable. Any advice, examples, or resources would be super helpful!

Thanks

comments.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
comments.body: This post is not specific to AI based game development. See rule #1.
